package demo;

import haxe.ds.StringMap;

/* Block comment */
@:keep
class Main {
    static var count:Int = 0x1F;

    @:noCompletion
    public static function greet(name:String, times:Int = 1):String {
        var text = 'Hello, $name! ${times + 1}\n';
        var plain = "no $interpolation here";
        return text + plain;
    }

    static function main() {
        #if debug
        trace("debug build");
        #end
        var map = new StringMap<Float>();
        map.set("pi", 3.14);
        if (count > 0 && !false) trace(greet("haxe", 2), null);
    }
}
